summary: A 44-year-old Clearwater, Florida man hiking in the Illinois Creek area was reported possibly suffering from heat exhaustion; the Western Mountain Rescue team was alerted and he returned in good health.
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; Western Mountain Rescue Team
notes: Per-incident one-liner from the Gunnison County Sheriff's Office weekly press release (June 25, 2018 edition; item misdated 06/19/19 in the release, week coverage pins 06/19/18). Mined run 463.
